cohort: 75 pregnant women with thrombocytopenia at a tertiary care center between January 1, 2021 and December 31, 2021.
finding: The most common cause of thrombocytopenia was gestational thrombocytopenia, followed by hypertensive disorders of pregnancy, and most women delivered vaginally.
mod_finding: The majority of women (59.09%) delivered vaginally, while 39.39% had a Cesarean section.
gest_age: Ranged from 34 to 37 weeks for the majority of participants (38.66%)
